The Company issued 1,01,00,000 share warrants convertible into equity shares of face value of Rs. 5 each on 1:1 basis on 20.01.2026 shareholders approval for whoch was received on 13.02.2026 in the EGM held on that date. Thereafter upon receipt of 25% of the upfront amount, the company has alloted 1,01,00,000 share warrants to Cupid Limited on 02.04.2026. Thereafter the company converted 15,00,000 share warrants into 15,00,000 equity shares of face value of Rs. 5 each on 18.05.2026 for which confirmation of Dematerialisation was received on 06.07.2026 effective from 03.07.2026.
As on date 86,00,000 share warrants are outstanding to be converted into equity shares of face value of Rs. 5 each.
